events.context: Lucia emails Jane requesting full refund of $43 charge, denies authorizing monthly subscription, states only attempted $7-day trial declined on March 26, did not use service after

Advisor criticizes unauthorized reactivation, provides draft reply email rejecting offer and demanding refund and cancellation, advises logging into site to cancel subscription and screenshot, contact bank for dispute
Lucia decides to call bank tomorrow for dispute, notes company's reply is self-sabotaging
Advisor provides script for bank call explaining unauthorized $43 charge, rejected trial, unauthorized upgrade and reactivation
Advisor reminds Lucia to login to Justdone site to cancel subscription and screenshot, save emails as evidence
Lucia asks 'priority queue是什么东西' (what is priority queue)
Advisor explains priority queue as data structure with elements by priority, uses heap implementation, provides Python heapq code example, applications, complexity table
Lucia asks '这个是data analyst用的吗' (is this used by data analysts)
Advisor explains priority queue not core for data analysts (SQL/Pandas suffice), useful for large-scale data, engineering, interviews; provides role-based table
Lucia requests '点评一下这个论文' (review this paper) on AI governance paper
Advisor provides detailed review of paper '人工智能治理中的表演性合规与制度性判断力——刺破公司面纱的启示', covers contributions, structure, highlights, controversies, evaluation table (4.7/5), suggestions
Lucia repeats '点评一下这个论文'

Advisor provides second detailed review of similar paper '人工智能治理中的判断力赤字：表演性合规与刺破公司面纱', covers contributions, structure, innovations, problems, prospects, score 9.0/10
